title: Sudden mastery of Morse code under threat of being sent to Vietnam

tellings.quote: Vietnam so I passed 10 12 15 20 uh 15 18 22 that day in like two hours something popped in my head

plain: In the 1960s, at an Army intelligence school, a soldier facing the threat of being shipped to Vietnam suddenly mastered Morse code, the system of sending letters as dots and dashes, jumping through speeds from 10 up to 22 words a minute in about two hours. The soldier was Joe McMoneagle, later known for psychic spying work, and he tells it himself, saying "something popped in my head" that day. He offers it as an early sign of an unusual ability in his mind.
